title: Bowling and Peg Leg Bates
summary: He bowled at the Savoy and visits Peg Leg Bates.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Bowling. I used to bowl every night in the Savoy. After 3:00, I'd go in to bowl if I wasn't going out jamming, from 4 to 10:00 in the morning. They used to have a board on the side of the wall that had the high score for the week. I was fortunate to have my name up there for 1 full week before somebody beat me -250. I have my own ball in my room now. I haven't picked it up for awhile. I had it made special in St. Louis. I've kept it with me, you know. But, I love bowling. I haven't bowled for
Have you kept up on any of the other sports?

(Inaudible). They always ask me to come down. My wife and myself went down there once. And, I couldn't move like I wanted to move. You know, I said don't hit that ball over there. I said hit it back to me. You know?

Till I get my legs straight. But, I go out, that's (inaudible), the health club I go into, and the bicycle riding. (Inaudible) want me to come over there. I've been making up my mind. I'm going over one day cause during the day, I don't have too much to do. Then, if I go out, I spend a couple of hours here. Sometimes, I get in the car. Like, I go see Peg Leg Bates some days. He's about 30 miles from here. I go up and we go in and talk about old times cause we used to do a lot of

He's doing fine. He got his own place there and he's doing very good. He, he's not dancing on that peg like he was before. He's taking it easy. But, I go up there and he'll stop the whole show to let the people know I'm there.
